note: Curated: a true THN synthase releases 1,3,6,8-tetrahydroxynaphthalene (T4HN) directly (PMID 10501004, 23261597). The starter and extender units are not stated in the abstracts that were read, so no substrate is listed. The bacterial type III PKS reaction of Rhea (EC 2.3.1.233, KEGG rppA) is a different enzyme class and is not used.

Curated: a hexaketide PKS releases 2-acetyl-1,3,6,8-tetrahydroxynaphthalene (AT4HN) (PMID 18676950). ChEBI has no entry for 2-acetyl-1,3,6,8-tetrahydroxynaphthalene (name searches and an InChIKey search on 2026-11-21 found none; PubChem CID 86018477, C12H10O5, InChIKey FYPSLERIHMOYRN-UHFFFAOYSA-N), so it is not a participant. The abstract shows AT4HN in the WdYG1 deletion mutant; it does not show the product of the PKS directly.

Rhea has no EC for this reaction. Rhea lists the charged species CHEBI:57288 and CHEBI:57384; mapped to the neutral parents. Small molecules (H2O, CO2, CoA, NADP(H), H+) are not listed as participants.

Chain shortening of the heptaketide YWA1 by the hydrolase Ayg1. Rhea has no EC for this reaction. Rhea lists acetoacetate CHEBI:13705 (1-); mapped to the neutral parent CHEBI:15344. Small molecules (H2O, CO2, CoA, NADP(H), H+) are not listed as participants.

Curated: deacetylation of the hexaketide AT4HN to T4HN by the Ayg1 orthologue Yg1 (PMID 18676950). ChEBI has no entry for 2-acetyl-1,3,6,8-tetrahydroxynaphthalene (name searches and an InChIKey search on 2026-11-21 found none; PubChem CID 86018477, C12H10O5, InChIKey FYPSLERIHMOYRN-UHFFFAOYSA-N), so it is not a participant. With no substrate in the table, path_possible cannot reach this reaction after another step.

Rhea writes the reaction in the oxidation direction (scytalone + NADP+ = T4HN + NADPH + H+). The roles are stored in the reduction direction that the step uses. KEGG KO K17739 is a cross-reference of the step. Small molecules (H2O, CO2, CoA, NADP(H), H+) are not listed as participants.

Curated: NADPH-dependent reduction of 1,3,8-trihydroxynaphthalene to vermelone. A Rhea search for 'vermelone' on 2026-11-21 returned no reaction. ChEBI:9957 is vermelone without stereochemistry (2 stars); ChEBI also has (+)-vermelone CHEBI:198683. Small molecules (H2O, CO2, CoA, NADP(H), H+) are not listed as participants.
KEGG KO K17740 is a cross-reference of the step. Small molecules (H2O, CO2, CoA, NADP(H), H+) are not listed as participants.

Curated: dehydration of vermelone to 1,8-dihydroxynaphthalene. Rhea has no reaction for vermelone (search on 2026-11-21). This reaction has its own evidence records; they are not copies of the scytalone edge. Which enzyme acts is not settled for every fungus: the abstract of PMID 10320327 names scytalone and vermelone as the two physiological substrates of scytalone dehydratase (Pyricularia oryzae enzyme, UniProt P56221); for the Aspergillus fumigatus cluster the abstracts that were read do not show which enzyme dehydrates vermelone (pathway review, O4). Small molecules (H2O, CO2, CoA, NADP(H), H+) are not listed as participants.

Curated: oxidative polymerisation of 1,8-dihydroxynaphthalene to DHN-melanin. The polymer has no formula (ChEBI:167605, 1,8-dihydroxynaphthalene-melanin, is a class entry), so no product is listed. The abstracts show colour phenotypes only: the substrate of each oxidase and the order of the laccase and the multicopper oxidase are not shown.

Curated shunt, no enzyme link: oxidation of T4HN to flaviolin. Flaviolin accumulates when the reduction of T4HN is blocked (arp2 deletants, PMID 10515939). That the oxidation is non-enzymatic is from the pathway review and was not checked in an abstract.
